extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath Agents evaluation import modal titled "Import datasets." The dialog asks how to add datasets and presents two selectable cards: "Upload file" and "Paste JSON array." The "Paste JSON array" option is highlighted with a red border, indicating it is the intended selection.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Paste JSON array option to import the evaluation set by pasting JSON directly.
